summary: Hold ordinary mail outside OMP and Claude native human decisions until their prompt resolves

replay.detail: No historical claim replay change. Unacknowledged mail remains durable and is re-offered by successor channels.

schema.detail: Adds a native harness episode lookup index; no persisted record schema change.

compatibility.detail: Uses existing human-blocked observations and delivery reason fields. No new wire fields or message lifecycle states.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption. OMP extensions pick up the rule on their next session start; Claude channels follow the replacement st binary.

manual.detail: No operator steps. Native questions still require native answers; ordinary mail cannot answer them.

recovery.detail: Prompt answer, dismissal, native resolution and session restart release the human hold. A Claude permission hook's polling timeout does not close its native dialog and does not release mail. Receipt recovery for previously offered Claude mail continues while new notifications wait; episode-fenced releases survive blocked-file heartbeats.
